review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Cortextual is a workforce transition platform built for companies restructuring around AI. It gives founders, COOs, and Heads of People a live view of org structure, workforce costs, and scenario planning — so they can make workforce decisions with real data before committing to them. Most companies are navigating some version of the same challenge: teams are changing, AI is being adopted, roles are shifting, and the cost of getting it wrong is higher than ever. But most leaders are making these decisions without seeing the full picture — what each role actually costs, where dependencies exist, and what could happen if someone leaves. Cortextual brings org structure, workforce costs, and scenario modeling into one live view — with visibility into dependencies and knowledge risk when you need it. Not a static diagram someone updated last quarter. A living view of how your organization works and what a change could cost before you make it. About role: Level: Senior. 5+ years operating production infrastructure, with at least 2 of those on self-managed (non-PaaS) systems. This role owns production directly and works largely independently — it is not a junior or platform-team-of-many position. Responsibilities: • PostgreSQL administration on self-managed infrastructure. Streaming replication, WAL archiving and point-in-time recovery (wal-g or equivalent), connection pooling (pgpool-II or PgBouncer), failover. You have restored a production database from a base backup plus WAL yourself, not supervised someone doing it. • AWS, hands-on and without a managed platform layer. EC2, application load balancing, Route 53 including private hosted zones, IAM, S3, ElastiCache/Valkey, DocumentDB. • Docker and Docker Compose as a production runtime across multiple hosts, with a reverse proxy at the edge (Traefik, nginx or similar). This is what the estate is; comfort with Compose in production, rather than a desire to replace it immediately, is a requirement. • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including administration and hardening of self-hosted runners that hold deployment credentials. • Backup, recovery and disaster-recovery ownership. Defining RPO/RTO, running restore drills, and writing runbooks other people can execute. • Monitoring and alerting from a standing start. Choosing what to alarm on, wiring notification paths, and keeping alert volume low enough that alerts stay meaningful. • Secrets management. AWS SSM Parameter Store or Secrets Manager, including migration off in-repository secrets and application-side retrieval. • Linux systems administration. systemd, cron, networking, storage and capacity, TLS certificate lifecycle. Preferred • Terraform, specifically importing an existing manually-built estate into state — a different skill from greenfield authoring, and the one this role needs first. • Ansible — it is the existing provisioning tool and comes with the job. • Experience operating queue-backed workloads (BullMQ, Laravel Horizon or comparable) where the broker holds job state. • Familiarity with log pipelines such as Vector, VictoriaLogs, Loki or the ELK stack. • PHP/Laravel or Node/NestJS application context — enough to debug a deploy, not to build features. • Working in a regulated or sensitive-data environment (HR, payroll, health, finance). Would be a plus • Kubernetes. The platform is Docker Compose on EC2 and will stay that way for the foreseeable term. Container-orchestration depth is neither needed nor a substitute for the essentials above. • Service mesh, multi-region architecture, or progressive delivery. Working requirements • Comfortable being the sole owner of production and the first responder for incidents, with a two-person on-call rotation. • Writes things down. A large part of the first quarter is turning undocumented, manually-operated infrastructure into documented, reproducible infrastructure. • Pragmatic about sequencing. Willing to fix backups and alerting before rebuilding the platform, and to leave working systems alone. • Able to work with the product engineers on shared boundaries — deploy gates, migration safety, edge rate limiting — without taking over application code. Mindset Team Player — Collaborates openly, shares ownership, and works effectively across design, product, and engineering teams. Positive — Brings a proactive, solution-oriented attitude and embraces challenges with curiosity and resilience. Product Mindset — Cares deeply about user experience and builds solutions that balance technical excellence with real customer value. What We Offer • Fully remote-first environment with flexible working. • Fast-moving, international team with a strong culture of ownership. • Learning & development budget. Join our team at Cortextual, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact!
